meta.title: HARTRON DEO MOCK TEST 1 (50 Questions)
meta.subtitle: Windows, Networking, Computer Fundamentals, Internet, HTML and MS Office
meta.intro: Welcome to Target1st. This is HARTRON DEO mock test one. Let's begin.
meta.outro: That was mock test one. Subscribe to Target1st for more.

questions.q: Which part of the computer is called its 'brain'?
points: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit
It contains the ALU, control unit and registers
It executes instructions and controls all other parts
questions.trick: ALU calculates, CU controls, registers remember.

questions.q: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
points: RAM loses its data when the power goes off
ROM and hard disk are non-volatile
RAM is the main working memory of a computer

questions.q: Which shortcut key is used to paste copied content in Windows?
points: Ctrl+V pastes the content from the clipboard
Ctrl+C copies and Ctrl+X cuts
Ctrl+Z undoes the last action
questions.trick: V looks like an arrow dropping content down.

questions.q: What is the full form of HTML?
points: HTML is the standard language for creating web pages
It uses tags written inside angle brackets
It was created by Tim Berners-Lee
questions.trick: H-T-M-L = HyperText Markup Language, not a programming language.

questions.q: What is the full form of LAN?
points: A LAN connects computers in a small area like an office
MAN covers a city and WAN covers a country or world
Ethernet is the most common LAN technology

questions.q: How many bits make one byte?
points: 1 byte = 8 bits
4 bits make one nibble
1 KB = 1024 bytes
questions.trick: Byte = Bit x 8, a nibble is half of it.

questions.q: What is the default file extension of a Microsoft Word 2016 document?
points: The .docx format started with Word 2007
Word 97 to 2003 used the .doc extension
A .dotx file is a Word template
questions.trick: the extra x means XML based.

questions.q: In Windows, where do deleted files go first by default?
points: Deleted files stay in the Recycle Bin until it is emptied
Shift+Delete removes a file permanently
Files can be restored from the Recycle Bin

questions.q: Which HTML tag creates the largest heading?
points: <h1> is the largest and <h6> is the smallest heading
<head> holds page information, not a heading
Headings run from <h1> to <h6>

questions.q: Which function is used to add numbers in MS Excel?
points: SUM adds all numbers in a range
Example: =SUM(A1:A5)
Every Excel formula starts with the = sign

questions.q: Which device is used to connect two different networks?
points: A router forwards packets between networks using IP addresses
A switch connects devices inside one LAN
A hub simply broadcasts data to all ports

questions.q: Which of the following is an output device?
points: A printer gives a hard copy of the output
Scanner, joystick and microphone are input devices
Monitor and speaker are also output devices
questions.trick: Printer Prints out, so it is output.

questions.q: Which of the following is an operating system?
points: Linux is an open source operating system
Chrome is a browser and Excel is application software
An OS manages hardware and software resources
questions.trick: OS = boss of the machine, apps are its workers.

questions.q: Which shortcut key locks a Windows computer?
points: Windows+L locks the screen instantly
Windows+D shows the desktop
Windows+M minimizes all open windows

questions.q: What is the full form of URL?
points: A URL is the address of a web page
Example: https://www.example.com
It has a protocol, domain name and path
questions.trick: U-R-L = Uniform Resource Locator, the web address.

questions.q: Which shortcut key switches between open windows in Windows?
points: Alt+Tab shows a list of open windows to switch between
Ctrl+Tab switches tabs inside a program
Windows+Tab opens Task View

questions.q: Which protocol is used to send e-mail from a client to a mail server?
points: SMTP sends mail, POP3 and IMAP receive it
FTP transfers files
HTTP is used for web pages

questions.q: Which of the following is the largest unit of storage?
points: 1 TB = 1024 GB
1 GB = 1024 MB and 1 MB = 1024 KB
Order: KB, MB, GB, TB, PB
questions.trick: KMGTP, Kids Make Good Tea Pots.

questions.q: Which of the following is a fully absolute cell reference in Excel?
points: $A$1 locks both the column and the row
A$1 locks only the row and $A1 only the column
Press F4 to switch between reference types
questions.trick: the $ sign is a lock, two locks mean absolute.

questions.q: Which HTML tag inserts a single line break?
points: breaks the line and needs no closing tag
<hr> draws a horizontal line
starts a new paragraph

questions.q: Which of the following is a private IP address?
points: Private ranges are 10.x.x.x, 172.16 to 172.31 and 192.168.x.x
8.8.8.8 is a public Google DNS address
Private addresses are not routed on the internet

questions.q: Which shortcut key opens the Run dialog box in Windows?
points: Windows+R opens Run, where commands like cmd can be typed
Windows+E opens File Explorer
Windows+I opens Settings

questions.q: Integrated circuits (ICs) were used in which generation of computers?
points: First: vacuum tubes, second: transistors
Third: integrated circuits, fourth: microprocessors
Fifth: artificial intelligence
questions.trick: V, T, I, M, A, vacuum, transistor, IC, microprocessor, AI.

questions.q: What is the default file extension of a PowerPoint 2016 presentation?
points: Older versions from 97 to 2003 used .ppt
A .ppsx file opens directly as a slide show
A .potx file is a PowerPoint template
questions.trick: pptx = PowerPoint XML, same x as docx.

questions.q: Which attribute of the tag gives alternate text for an image?
points: The alt text shows when the image cannot load
src holds the image file path
href is used with the <a> tag

questions.q: Which network topology uses a central hub or switch?
points: In a star topology every device connects to a central device
If one cable fails, only that device is affected
Bus uses a single backbone cable
questions.trick: star has a centre, like the sun.

questions.q: Which Windows tool is used to create and manage disk partitions?
points: Disk Management can create, format and resize partitions
Device Manager handles hardware drivers
Event Viewer shows system logs

questions.q: Which protocol is used for secure web browsing?
points: HTTPS encrypts data using SSL/TLS
HTTPS uses port 443 and HTTP uses port 80
The padlock in the browser shows HTTPS

questions.q: Which shortcut key centers the selected text in MS Word?
points: Ctrl+E centers, Ctrl+L left aligns, Ctrl+R right aligns
Ctrl+J justifies the text
These shortcuts work in Word and PowerPoint

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT an input device?
points: A plotter is an output device used for large drawings
Scanner, webcam and touchpad send data into the computer
Plotters are used by architects and engineers
questions.trick: Plotter Plots out, it is output.

questions.q: Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing of packets?
points: The Network layer is layer 3 and uses IP addresses
The Data Link layer uses MAC addresses
The Transport layer provides end to end delivery

questions.q: Which HTML tag is used to create a hyperlink?
points: The <a> anchor tag creates a link
The href attribute holds the destination address
Example: Click
questions.trick: a = anchor, href = where to go.

questions.q: Which Excel function returns the largest value in a range?
points: MAX returns the highest number in the range
MIN returns the lowest number
Example: =MAX(B2:B10)

questions.q: Which file system is the default for modern Windows installations?
points: NTFS supports large files, security and compression
FAT32 cannot store a single file above 4 GB
ext4 is used in Linux

questions.q: What is the binary equivalent of the decimal number 10?
points: 10 = 8 + 2, so bits 8 and 2 are on
Place values run 8, 4, 2, 1

questions.q: What is the default port number of the FTP control connection?
points: FTP uses port 21 for commands
22 is SSH, 23 is Telnet and 25 is SMTP
FTP transfers files between computers
questions.trick: FTP = 21, like the 21 gun salute for files.

questions.q: What does CSS stand for?
points: CSS controls the look and layout of web pages
It separates design from the HTML content
CSS can be inline, internal or external
questions.trick: Cascading means styles flow from top to bottom.

questions.q: Which Excel function looks up a value in the first column of a table and returns a value from another column?
points: VLOOKUP searches vertically down the first column
HLOOKUP searches across the first row
Example: =VLOOKUP(A2,A1:C10,3,FALSE)

questions.q: Which command in Command Prompt shows the IP configuration of a Windows computer?
points: ipconfig shows IP address, subnet mask and gateway
ifconfig is the Linux equivalent
ping tests whether another host is reachable

questions.q: Which protocol converts domain names into IP addresses?
points: DNS works like the phonebook of the internet
DHCP assigns IP addresses automatically
ARP finds the MAC address for an IP

questions.q: Which HTML tag defines a table row?
points: <tr> is table row and <td> is table data
<th> is a table heading cell
<table> is the outer container

questions.q: Which key starts a PowerPoint slide show from the first slide?
points: F5 starts the show from the beginning
Shift+F5 starts it from the current slide
F7 runs the spelling check
questions.trick: F5 = Five stars, start the show.

questions.q: Which small, very fast memory is located inside the CPU?
points: Registers hold data the CPU is working on right now
They are the smallest and fastest memory
RAM is outside the CPU chip
questions.trick: Register sits Right inside the CPU.

questions.q: Which attribute of the <a> tag opens a link in a new browser tab?
points: target="_blank" opens the link in a new tab or window
The default target is _self, the same tab
href holds the link address

questions.q: What is the default subnet mask of a Class C network?
points: Class A uses 255.0.0.0 and Class B uses 255.255.0.0
Class C first octet ranges from 192 to 223
Class C allows 254 hosts per network
questions.trick: A one 255, B two 255s, C three 255s.

questions.q: What does the error #DIV/0! mean in MS Excel?
points: A number was divided by zero or an empty cell
#REF! means an invalid cell reference
#NAME? means Excel does not know the name
questions.trick: DIV/0 literally says divide by zero.

questions.q: Which shortcut key lets you snip a selected area of the screen in Windows 10 and 11?
points: Windows+Shift+S opens the snipping toolbar
PrtScn captures the whole screen
Alt+PrtScn captures only the active window
questions.trick: Shift the Snip, S for Snip.

questions.q: Which HTML5 element is used to define a navigation menu?
points: <nav> holds the main navigation links of a page
<header> holds introductory content
<footer> holds the bottom part of a page

questions.q: Which transport layer protocol is connectionless?
points: UDP sends data without setting up a connection
It is faster but does not guarantee delivery
TCP is connection oriented and reliable

questions.q: What is the ASCII value of the capital letter A?
points: Capital A is 65 and small a is 97
Digit 0 is 48
Capital Z is 90
